nodes.name: Sklearn Tree Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level public sklearn.tree estimator-selection, callback-boundary, and fitted-state atoms above Cython tree-builder, splitter, criterion, pruning, and prediction boundaries.

nodes.name: tree_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose the public sklearn.tree estimator names useful for framework-level model selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: tree_estimator_family
nodes.description: Return whether a public tree estimator belongs to the decision-tree or extra-tree family.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time membership lookup over fixed estimator sets.

nodes.name: tree_estimator_task
nodes.description: Return the high-level supervised learning task for a public tree estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time membership lookup over classifier names.

nodes.name: tree_estimator_backend
nodes.description: Return the native tree-builder backend boundary behind a public tree estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates a fixed estimator name and returns the shared native backend label.

nodes.name: tree_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level tree-estimator routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom selects one fixed method tuple by estimator name.

nodes.name: tree_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public tree fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing native tree building.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object, sample_weight: object = None, check_input: bool = True) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates finite dense fit inputs and packages references, leaving fitting to sklearn.

nodes.name: tree_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public tree prediction-like method payload without executing the estimator method.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates finite dense prediction input and packages references, leaving prediction execution to sklearn.

nodes.name: tree_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public tree estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: tree_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose compact fitted tree metadata after the deferred native tree builder.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes scalar tree metadata and optional class arrays already produced by sklearn fitting.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 1 public tree estimator shells over Cython tree-builder, splitter, criterion, pruning, and prediction boundaries
limitations: The internal algorithmic topology is obscured by sklearn Cython tree-builder, splitter, and criterion boundaries.
The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not sparse inputs, tree growth, split search, impurity criteria, pruning execution, or prediction internals.
